summary: Iteration 874 — Suggested AI Specialists strip: full-stack verification for user-facing conversion strip on 37 canonical feature pages. Backend endpoints (GET /api/access-control/feature-specialists/{feature_key} and POST /click) verified sanitized, correct auth, mongo persistence. Frontend strip verified across /features/ai-writer, /features/fitness, /ai-briefing (mobile+desktop) with pill regression + coaching-team routing + dismiss persistence.

issues: Strip container has fixed maxWidth=600 while viewport is 390px, causing strip bounding box to extend beyond viewport edges (x=-105, width=600). Not functionally broken since inner chips are in a horizontal ScrollView, but the pill+strip appear left-shifted and can extend off-screen. Consider constraining maxWidth to min(600, viewportWidth - 24).

action_items: Minor: mobile strip overflow — clamp maxWidth in SuggestedSpecialistsStrip.tsx to viewport width minus horizontal margin (design polish only, functionality intact).
critical_code_review_comments: SuggestedSpecialistsStrip.tsx: clean, ~150 lines, single responsibility, correctly gated on session + featureKey + dismissed state; API errors are silently swallowed (setSpecialists remains empty) which correctly hides the strip — good UX.

Backend feature_specialists route uses strict SPECIALIST_PUBLIC_FIELDS allow-list projection preventing leakage of system_prompt / allowed_tools / permissions / provider / model / config_profile — verified via test_specialists_sanitized_and_relevant and parametric spot-check across 5 feature keys.
